description: This file defines a Java interface 'KafkaConnectionFactory' responsible for creating Kafka connection instances such as producers and providing a connection identifier within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: KafkaConnectionFactory
classes.description: A Java interface for creating Kafka connections, including obtaining a connection ID and producing Kafka message producers.

methods.name: connectionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the Kafka connection.

methods.name: newProducer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Kafka message producer.
